title: Come, Thou Almighty King
description: Come, Thou Almighty King in Tonic Solfa to ITALIAN HYMN: the solfa with the words, staff notation, the five verses, and a piano.
about: The author of these words is unknown; they were printed in a leaflet bound into the 1757 edition of George Whitefield’s Collection of Hymns for Social Worship. Felice de Giardini wrote the tune ITALIAN HYMN for them, published in 1769.
underlay: Come, Thou al-might_-y King, Help us Thy name__ to sing, Help us to praise! Fa-ther all glo-ri-ous, O’er all vic-to-ri-ous, Come and reign o-ver us, An-cient of Days!

lines: Help us Thy name to sing,
Our souls on Thee be stayed;
To Thee, great One in Three,
